Regen Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 4, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Everlight Digital ("we", "us") collects, uses, and shares information when you use the Regen recovery dashboard ("Regen") on iPhone and Apple Watch.

Information We Collect

  • Account data: Regen uses Sign in with Apple or email + password via Firebase Authentication. We store the resulting account identifier and, if applicable, your email address.
  • Health data: If you grant HealthKit permission, Regen reads heart-rate variability (HRV), resting heart rate (RHR), sleep, active energy, and workouts from Apple Health. Regen does not read body mass.
  • Settings: Unit preferences, dashboard configuration, and notification preferences stored locally.
  • Device / diagnostic data: Device model, iOS version, watchOS version, app version, and crash logs.

Apple Health readings, GPS routes, and logged lifting weights stay on your device and are not synced to your account. If you are signed in and use cloud coaching (chat, weekly review, insights, or Coach Notes), a numeric summary of your recent health data (HRV, resting heart rate, sleep hours, workout duration, heart rate, distance, and effort, and your recovery score) is sent to our server and to our AI provider, Anthropic, to generate your coaching. On Pro, Elite, and Founder plans, the weekly review sends this summary automatically on Mondays when you open the app. Coach Notes are saved to your account; chat messages are not. That summary travels over TLS and is tied to your account.

How We Use Information

  • To compute your recovery score, training load, baseline, and freshness
  • To display dashboards, charts, and history
  • To send the notifications you have enabled
  • To diagnose crashes and improve the app

How We Share Information

  • Apple HealthKit — read on your device, controlled by you in iOS Settings > Health
  • Apple (Sign in with Apple, App Store, push notifications)
  • Google Firebase (Authentication, Cloud Functions, Firestore) — account sign-in. When you use cloud coaching, Cloud Functions receive the numeric summary over TLS, tied to your account. Firestore stores Coach Notes under your account. Chat messages are not stored. Apple Health readings are not synced to your account.
  • Google Firebase Analytics — product events, with no health values and no user ID
  • Anthropic — receives that numeric summary, via the Cloud Function, to generate your coaching

We do not sell your data and Regen contains no advertising trackers.

Children

Regen is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect their personal information.

Your Rights

You can revoke HealthKit access at any time in iOS Settings > Privacy > Health > Regen. Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored data. EU/UK users have GDPR rights; California users have CCPA rights. Contact brendan@everlight-digital.com.

Security

HealthKit data on your device is encrypted by iOS. App data is sandboxed per Apple platform standards. The coaching summary is sent over TLS and is tied to your account.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy. Material changes will be announced in-app.
